title: Make uploads retry through the sanctioned helper
carries: Retries must go through uplink.util.retry.call_with_retry (with a name), not net/backoff.py or a new loop; only call_with_retry feeds the ops counters and backoff is being deleted.
why_not_in_repo: The rule was given in session 1 while the work was unrelated to retries, so session 1 leaves no retry call behind. The repository holds two working helpers and nothing says which one is allowed; net/backoff.py has the nicer decorator interface.

learn: User rule: when something needs retries use uplink.util.retry.call_with_retry with a descriptive name, not net/backoff.py and not a new retry loop. backoff is being deleted and only call_with_retry feeds the ops counters.
